name: transcription factor 7 like 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TCF7L2 encodes transcription factor 7-like 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colon Adenocarcinoma; Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Hepatocellular Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
